armpkgs.usage: Usage: /armpkgs <package>. Example: /armpkgs htop. Compare arm64 (AArch64) support for the package across Gentoo, Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch Linux ARM, and AUR.

pkgs.usage: Usage: /pkgs <package>. Example: /pkgs firefox. Compare package versions across Gentoo, AUR, Arch, Alpine, Debian, Ubuntu, Nixpkgs, Fedora, RHEL, CentOS Stream, and openSUSE. Debian and similar distributions show stable/testing channels; RHEL data comes from AlmaLinux and Rocky Linux.
